hint: brother of Elrond, first King of Númenor from S.A. 32

title: Tar-Aldarion
hint: the Mariner King of Númenor who made Vinyalondë

title: Erendis
hint: Tar-Elestirnë, wife of Tar-Aldarion, estranged by his love of the sea

title: Tar-Ancalimë
hint: first Ruling Queen of Númenor, daughter of Aldarion and Erendis

title: Tar-Palantir
hint: the Far-sighted, last faithful King of Númenor

title: Ar-Pharazôn
hint: the Golden, last King of Númenor; assailed Valinor in S.A. 3319

title: Tar-Míriel
hint: daughter of Tar-Palantir, forced to wed Ar-Pharazôn; drowned in the Downfall

title: Amandil
hint: last Lord of Andúnië, father of Elendil; sailed West to plead with the Valar
